title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E5 — Sandwiches
Five classic sandwiches -- roasted chicken club, New Orleans po'boy with oysters, muffuletta, applewood-smoked bacon and fried egg sandwich, and a Reuben.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E7 — French Bistro Classics
Lamb navarin; Niçoise salad; a melted ham and cheese croque monsieur topped with a béchamel sauce; celery root rémoulade.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E8 — The Grind
Glazed meatloaf; hot Italian-style pork sausage; making burgers using a custom blend of meats; meatballs with ricotta.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E9 — Cooking With Wine
Beef bourguignon; cioppino, a tomato and wine-based fish stew; chicken Marsala; poached pears in red or white wine.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E10 — Italian Favorites
Eight-layer pork ragù; béchamel-filled lasagna baked in ramekins; chicken Parmesan; raviolo with an egg yolk and ricotta-spinach filling; linguine with clam sauce.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E11 — On the Bone
Oxtail; slow-roasted beef ribs; cowboy steak; Korean short rib kebabs.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E12 — Cheese
Cheese fondue; fettuccine Alfredo; melting raclette; grown-up grilled cheese.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E13 — Lamb
Butterflied, rolled and roasted leg of lamb; lamb tagine with spiced butternut squash and prunes; yogurt-marinated lamb kebabs; seared loin lamb chops served with mint jelly and fried fingerling potatoes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E2 — The Perfect Jams to Pair With a Simple Breakfast
One of Martha's favorite things to do is to make jam with the perfectly ripened fruit and berries grown on her Bedford farm; Martha shares her favorite recipes, as well as jam and jarring techniques.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E2 — The Art of Raw Food
Martha and Omar Abou-Ismail make miso soup and a bean-free hummus with flatbread made with raw ingredients; Martha and Omar whip up a tabouli salad followed by sweet potato fries.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E3 — Baking Baguettes and Breads
Martha tours Breads Bakery with owner Gadi Paleg and learns about their award-winning baked goods; Martha and bakers make Breads Bakery's baguette, challah, and egg sandwich.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E4 — Chef David Burke's Modern Classics
Chef David Burke brings his modern classic dishes to Martha's kitchen; a bacon clothesline, calamari noodles, miso chicken with ginger and vegetables, and key lime pie are on the menu.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E5 — All Things Yogurt
Homa Dashtaki, owner of the White Moustache yogurt company, shares her technique for making yogurt, Persian rice with a yogurt dip, and whey pancakes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E2 — Japanese Knife Skills
Martha takes a deep dive into how to choose and maintain the best knives; Chef Masa Takayama shares his superior knife skills and world renowned dishes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E4 — Arethusa Farm Dairy's Award Winning Cheese
Martha road trips to Arethusa Farm in Bantam, CT, and learns how they make their award-winning Europa cheese, visits their cheese caves, and makes their delicious cheesy risotto recipe.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E11 — Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began for Martha in the 1970s; then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour - a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E12 — Color For All Seasons
One of the joys of gardening is planning for beautiful color all through the year; bulbs and tubers are at the center of this show because of their beautiful blooms from spring to winter.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E7 — Coconut Cake; Arranging Roses; Tag Sale
Picture frames; coconut cake; flower arrangements; tag sale.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E8 — Making Pie; Felt Rounds; Sandblasting; Tool Kit; Bird House
Blueberry pie; felt rounds for dishes; sandblasting; tool kit.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E12 — Antiques; Scented Sugars; Rewiring a Lamp; Olive Bread
Guthman Antiques; scented sugars; rewiring a lamp; olive bread.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E18 — Chair Refinishing; Fruit Crumble; French Fries
Refinishing a chair; storing salt and pepper in bowls; apple crumble recipe; cleaning pots.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E19 — Urban Archaeology; Chocolate Curls and Cakes; Potpourri
Urban archaeology; chocolate recipes; potpourri; frozen cookie dough.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E20 — Bottle Gardening; Wall Painting; Decorative Boxes
Decorative gift boxes; terrariums; decorative wall painting; washing bottles.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E12 — Biscuits and Scones
Buttermilk biscuits; angel biscuits; cream scones.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E13 — Muffins and Popovers
Blueberry muffins two ways -- flavored with spice or finished with a crumb topping; airy popovers that can be served with blueberry preserves or creamed spinach.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E1 — Coffee Cakes
Rhubarb upside-down crumb cake; jam-filled coffee cake muffins; streusel cake; glazed lemon-blueberry coffee cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E2 — Shortbread
Shortbread wedges; brown-butter shortbread lemon bars; brown sugar pecan shortbread cookies; pumpkin tart.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E4 — Cookies
Brown sugar chocolate chip cookies; old-fashioned lemon sugar cookies; chewy chocolate ginger-molasses cookies; sable; glazed citrus doodles.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E8 — The Science of Woks and Frying
Martha and Chef Kenji Lopez-Alt make extra-crunchy fried chicken sandwiches, tempura shrimp with vegetables, and finally a perfectly stir-fried beef with broccoli.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E2 — The Perfect Jams to Pair With a Simple Breakfast
One of Martha's favorite things to do is to make jam with the perfectly ripened fruit and berries grown on her Bedford farm; Martha shares her favorite recipes, as well as jam and jarring techniques.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E3 — How to Properly Cook an Egg
Meet Martha in one of her favorite places on the farm - the chicken coop to talk about one of her favorite things to eat - eggs; Martha will share her top methods for making an egg-cellent breakfast.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E4 — Pasta Night
Tonight is pasta night in Bedford; Martha and friends make three pasta dishes, including a recipe from her new restaurant, The Bedford, a no-knife spaghetti, and a lemon angel hair pasta.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E10 — Braising
Which cuts of meat are good for braising; classic pot roast; braised cabbage with apples; pulled pork sandwiches.
